Allocation, lifetime, concurrency and validation for ethtool_rxfh_context store, key_off and priv_size.
Timer arming, retry limits and state transitions for ethtool_mmsv verification.
Contents of link_mode_params, valid mode range and link mode mask bit count value.
Meanings of hfunc selectors, input_xfrm values and timestamp qualifier and source enumerations.

findings.text: Extended link report holds selector link_ext_state plus one detail slot interpreted per selector. Detail choices are autoneg then link_training then link_logical_mismatch then bad_signal_integrity then cable_issue then module, with fallback __link_ext_substate as raw 32-bit value when no typed choice applies. Each named choice uses its own enumeration.

Physical link loss accounting is a single 64-bit counter link_down_events that advances only on genuine physical loss. It intentionally diverges from device carrier counters that also move on local reconfiguration or when management bridging keeps host link up. Internal width stays 64-bit to permit sentinel comparison while only low 32 bits surface externally.
Default receive-hash indirection resolves a table position to a queue by remainder of index against ring count. Caller supplies position index plus total n_rx_rings and receives ring selector.

Receive-hash context descriptor stores table extent indir_size plus key extent key_size plus user-visible table extent indir_user_size plus private extent priv_size plus hash selector hfunc plus transform selector input_xfrm plus flags indir_configured with key_configured plus offset key_off plus trailing pointer-aligned flexible store data. Store layout is private area first then indirection table then key. Accessors expose private start at store base then indirection start after private length rounded up to 32-bit alignment then key at recorded offset.

Link-mode capability entry records speed in speed plus lane count in lanes plus minimum pair requirement in min_pairs plus pair count in pairs plus duplex mode in duplex plus medium coverage in mediums. Speed uses signed integer, lane and pair counts use small unsigned, duplex uses small unsigned, mediums uses 16-bit mask.

ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_BASET means zero then ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_BASEK means one then ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_BASES means two then ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_BASEC means three then ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_BASEL means four then ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_BASED means five then ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_BASEE means six then ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_BASEF means seven then ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_BASEV means eight then ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_BASEMLD means nine then ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_NONE means ten with __ETHTOOL_LINK_MEDIUM_LAST marking eleven. ETHTOOL_MEDIUM_FIBER_BITS groups BaseS variant with BaseL variant with BaseF variant.
Pair-count query takes mode index and returns pairs field of corresponding parameter entry.

Kernel link settings combine base configuration in base with three mode masks for supported then advertising then lp_advertising plus lane count in lanes. Each mask is a bitmap sized to shared mask bit count. Anonymous grouping holds the three masks together.

Mode-mask helpers operate on a named mask within settings. Zeroing clears the whole named mask. Adding sets the bit indexed by named mode. Removing clears that indexed bit. Testing reads that indexed bit. Bit index derives from mode name through generated bit constant.

Energy-efficient state holds masks for supported then advertised then lp_advertised plus transmit idle timer in tx_lpi_timer plus flags for tx_lpi_enabled then eee_active then eee_enabled. Kernel coalescing extension holds queue-mode selectors use_cqe_mode_tx with use_cqe_mode_rx plus transmit aggregation limits tx_aggr_max_bytes with tx_aggr_max_frames with tx_aggr_time_usecs plus receive controls rx_cqe_frames with rx_cqe_nsecs.

Coalescing selectors map positions zero through thirty in order to receive delay then receive frames then receive IRQ delay then receive IRQ frames then transmit delay then transmit frames then transmit IRQ delay then transmit IRQ frames then stats block then adaptive receive then adaptive transmit then low packet rate then low receive delay then low receive frames then low transmit delay then low transmit frames then high packet rate then high receive delay then high receive frames then high transmit delay then high transmit frames then sample interval then CQE receive then CQE transmit then aggregation bytes then aggregation frames then aggregation time then receive profile then transmit profile then CQE frames then CQE nanoseconds.

Full coalescing coverage spans bit thirty down to zero. Groupings combine receive with transmit delay then receive with transmit frames then receive with transmit IRQ delays then receive with transmit IRQ frame limits then adaptive receive with adaptive transmit then four low-high delay members then four low-high frame members then CQE receive with CQE transmit then three transmit aggregation members then adaptive receive with low receive delay with high receive delay with low packet rate with high packet rate with sample interval.
Unset statistics use all-ones 64-bit sentinel. Initializer fills a caller array of given length with that sentinel, iterating from the end toward the start.

Ethernet statistics descriptors share a source selector src plus a grouped 64-bit counter block. MAC block tracks transmit and receive frame and octet totals with collision then deferral then error then multicast then broadcast then length-error breakdowns. PHY carrier block tracks SymbolErrorDuringCarrier. Generic block tracks rx_packets with rx_bytes with rx_errors plus tx_packets with tx_bytes with tx_errors. Control block tracks MACControlFramesTransmitted with MACControlFramesReceived with UnsupportedOpcodesReceived. Pause block tracks tx_pause_frames with rx_pause_frames with tx_pause_storm_events.
Limits fix maximum lanes to eight then FEC histogram slots to seventeen then RMON histogram slots to eleven then module EEPROM page length to 128 bytes then maximum module I2C address to 0x7f.

FEC ranges pair low with high bounds. Value entries hold sum with per_lane array sized to lane maximum. Histogram holds values array of seventeen entries with ranges pointer with ranges_buf inline storage of same capacity. Statistics hold corrected_blocks with uncorrectable_blocks with corrected_bits, each with total plus lanes array.

RMON ranges pair low with high bounds. RMON statistics combine source selector src with grouped counters for undersize_pkts then oversize_pkts then fragments then jabbers plus receive histogram hist with transmit histogram hist_tx each sized to eleven. Timestamp statistics group transmit counters for pkts with onestep_pkts_unconfirmed with lost with err.
Module EEPROM request holds offset with length with page with bank with i2c_address plus data pointer. Power parameters hold policy with mode.

MAC-merge state reports verification timing verify_time with ceiling max_verify_time with status verify_status plus flags tx_enabled with tx_active with pmac_enabled with verify_enabled plus fragment minima tx_min_frag_size with rx_min_frag_size. Configuration subset carries verify_time with verify_enabled with tx_enabled with pmac_enabled with tx_min_frag_size. Merge counters are MACMergeFrameAssErrorCount with MACMergeFrameSmdErrorCount with MACMergeFrameAssOkCount with MACMergeFragCountRx with MACMergeFragCountTx with MACMergeHoldCount.

Verification endpoint holds status with verify_timer with verify_retries with verify_enabled plus tx_enabled plus pmac_enabled plus verify_time. Event set is ETHTOOL_MMSV_LP_SENT_VERIFY_MPACKET with ETHTOOL_MMSV_LD_SENT_VERIFY_MPACKET with ETHTOOL_MMSV_LP_SENT_RESPONSE_MPACKET. Packet set is ETHTOOL_MPACKET_VERIFY with ETHTOOL_MPACKET_RESPONSE. Exchange proceeds via timed retries and packet round-trips toward active transmission.

Endpoint embeds spinlock lock alongside mutable verification state. No acquisition sites or ordering are visible in these fragments, so holders and critical sections are absent here; presence implies timer and configuration paths must coordinate through it.

Merge helper table offers transmit activation toggle configure_tx then preemption toggle configure_pmac then packet emission send_mpacket. Each receives endpoint reference plus requested state or packet kind.

Receive-hash parameters carry hash selector hfunc with table extent indir_size with table pointer indir with key extent key_size with key pointer key plus context selector rss_context with deletion flag rss_delete with transform input_xfrm. Field selector carries data with flow_type with rss_context. Timestamp info carries command cmd with software flags so_timestamping with PHC index phc_index plus qualifier phc_qualifier with source phc_source with PHY index phc_phyindex plus transmit types tx_types with receive filters rx_filters.

Operation serialization flags assign link settings to bit zero then private flags to one then ring parameters to two then channels to three then coalescing to four then pause query to five then pause configure to six then RSS to seven then link query to eight then self-test to nine. Presence of a bit requires holding RTNL during that operation.

Driver operation table starts with capability and sizing prefix holding supported_input_xfrm with cap_link_lanes_supported with rxfh_per_ctx_fields with rxfh_per_ctx_key with cap_rss_rxnfc_adds plus rxfh_indir_space with rxfh_key_space with rxfh_priv_size plus rxfh_max_num_contexts plus supported_coalesce_params with supported_ring_params with supported_hwtstamp_qualifiers plus op_needs_rtnl. Remainder is optional callback pointers keyed by operation.

Device control entries are get_drvinfo then get_regs_len then get_regs then get_wol then set_wol then get_msglevel then set_msglevel then nway_reset then get_link then get_link_ext_state then get_link_ext_stats then get_eeprom_len then get_eeprom then set_eeprom then begin then complete then get_priv_flags then set_priv_flags then get_strings then get_sset_count then get_ethtool_stats then flash_device then reset then set_phys_id then self_test then get_dump_flag then get_dump_data then set_dump. Each takes device reference plus operation buffers and returns status or fills outputs.

Queue and steering entries are get_coalesce then set_coalesce then get_ringparam then set_ringparam then get_pause_stats then get_pauseparam then set_pauseparam then get_rxnfc then set_rxnfc then get_rx_ring_count then get_rxfh_key_size then get_rxfh_indir_size then get_rxfh then set_rxfh then get_rxfh_fields then set_rxfh_fields then create_rxfh_context then modify_rxfh_context then remove_rxfh_context then get_channels then set_channels then get_per_queue_coalesce then set_per_queue_coalesce then get_tunable then set_tunable then get_phy_tunable then set_phy_tunable. Each takes device plus queue or flow descriptors plus optional diagnostic ack.

Settings and telemetry entries are get_ts_info then get_ts_stats then get_module_info then get_module_eeprom then get_eee then set_eee then get_link_ksettings then set_link_ksettings then get_fec_stats then get_fecparam then set_fecparam then get_ethtool_phy_stats then get_eth_phy_stats then get_eth_mac_stats then get_eth_ctrl_stats then get_rmon_stats then get_module_eeprom_by_page then set_module_eeprom_by_page then get_module_power_mode then set_module_power_mode then get_mm then set_mm then get_mm_stats. Each takes device plus settings or statistics buffers plus optional diagnostic ack.

Callers must ensure ring count is nonzero before default mapping with private length and key offset inside trailing store with statistic arrays initialized to sentinel before use with histogram and lane indexes bounded by stated maxima with EEPROM offset plus length plus page plus bank plus address and buffer validated plus mode masks sized to shared bit count.
Alignment helper lives in another dossier; local indirection accessor relies on it to round private length.
